appearances.snippet: came to fruition when a man named John T. ... Golle incorporated educational alternatives up in Minnesota. ... It was called Educational Alternatives Incorporated. ... John T. verification.notes: Education Week reports that Education Alternatives Inc. was formed in 1986 and later bought by John Golle, which does not support wording that he incorporated it. A Washington Post profile confirms a Good Morning America segment about the company, but current evidence did not establish that Jeb Bush appeared with Golle.
